svg.title: LDA and QDA decision regions
svg.desc: Two scatter plots with shaded decision regions. Left: two Gaussian classes with different covariance but the same mean, where QDA separates them with a quadratic boundary that here forms a cross dividing the plane into four regions of alternating class. Right: two classes with equal covariance and different means, where LDA draws a straight line between them.
svg.text: Blue and rose regions are the predicted classes; dots are samples. A linear boundary cannot separate the left data.
